ace_of_hearts.name: Ace of Hearts
ace_of_hearts.meaning: Love and happiness. The home, a love letter. This card is a particularly favorable card that indicates troubles and problems lifting.

king_of_hearts.name: King of Hearts
king_of_hearts.meaning: A fair-haired man with a good nature; or a man with Water signs predominating in his chart. Fair, helpful advice. Affectionate, caring man. This man helps you out without much talk. His actions reveal his kindness and concern.

queen_of_hearts.name: Queen of Hearts
queen_of_hearts.meaning: A fair-haired woman with a good nature; or a woman with Water signs predominating in her chart. Kind advice. Affectionate, caring woman. Sometimes, this card can indicate the mother or a mother figure.

jack_of_hearts.name: Jack of Hearts
jack_of_hearts.meaning: A warm-hearted friend. A fair-haired youth; or a young person with Water signs predominating in his or her chart. Often this points to a younger admirer.

10_of_hearts.name: 10 of Hearts
10_of_hearts.meaning: Good luck, success. This is an important card that suggests good fortune after difficulty.

9_of_hearts.name: 9 of Hearts
9_of_hearts.meaning: The card of wishes. A wish/dream fulfilled. Look to the card just preceding this one to determine what the querent desires.

8_of_hearts.name: 8 of Hearts
8_of_hearts.meaning: Unexpected gift or visit; an invitation to a party.

7_of_hearts.name: 7 of Hearts
7_of_hearts.meaning: Someone whose interest in you is unreliable; someone with fickle affections for you. This card can indicate lovesickness.

6_of_hearts.name: 6 of Hearts
6_of_hearts.meaning: A sudden wave of good luck. Someone takes care of you, takes warm interest in you.

5_of_hearts.name: 5 of Hearts
5_of_hearts.meaning: Jealousy; some ill-will from people around you.

4_of_hearts.name: 4 of Hearts
4_of_hearts.meaning: Travel, change of home or business.

3_of_hearts.name: 3 of Hearts
3_of_hearts.meaning: Love and happiness when the entire spread is generally favorable. In a difficult spread, this can indicate emotional problems and an inability to decide who to love.

2_of_hearts.name: 2 of Hearts
2_of_hearts.meaning: A warm partnership or engagement. This is a very favorable card that indicates strength and support coming from a partner.

ace_of_clubs.name: Ace of Clubs
ace_of_clubs.meaning: Wealth, prosperity, unexpected money/gain. However, in a difficult spread, this money may disappear almost as quickly as it appears.

king_of_clubs.name: King of Clubs
king_of_clubs.meaning: Dark-haired, kind-hearted man; or a man with Fire predominating in his chart. A generous, spirited man.

queen_of_clubs.name: Queen of Clubs
queen_of_clubs.meaning: Dark-haired, confident woman; or a woman with Fire predominating in her chart. She may give you good advice.

jack_of_clubs.name: Jack of Clubs
jack_of_clubs.meaning: A dark-haired or fiery youth. Popular youth who is good-hearted and playful. Can also indicate an admirer.

10_of_clubs.name: 10 of Clubs
10_of_clubs.meaning: Business success. Good luck with money. A trip taken now may result in a new friend or love interest.

9_of_clubs.name: 9 of Clubs
9_of_clubs.meaning: Achievement; sometimes a wealthy marriage or a sudden windfall.

8_of_clubs.name: 8 of Clubs
8_of_clubs.meaning: Work/business problems that may have to do with jealousy. This is generally thought to be quite unfavorable.

7_of_clubs.name: 7 of Clubs
7_of_clubs.meaning: Business success, although there may be problems in love. A change in business that may have been expected or earned, such as a promotion.

4_of_clubs.name: 4 of Clubs
4_of_clubs.meaning: Beware of dishonesty or deceit; avoid blind acceptance of others at this time.

3_of_clubs.name: 3 of Clubs
3_of_clubs.meaning: Love and happiness; successful marriage; a favorable long-term proposition. A second chance, particularly in an economical sense.

ace_of_spades.name: Ace of Spades
ace_of_spades.meaning: Misfortune; sometimes associated with death or, more often, a difficult ending.

king_of_spades.name: King of Spades
king_of_spades.meaning: Dark-haired man; or a man with Air predominating in his chart. An ambitious man, perhaps self-serving.

queen_of_spades.name: Queen of Spades
queen_of_spades.meaning: Widowed or divorced woman; or a woman with Air predominating in her chart.

jack_of_spades.name: Jack of Spades
jack_of_spades.meaning: A youth who is hostile or jealous.

9_of_spades.name: 9 of Spades
9_of_spades.meaning: Illness, accident, bad luck. The querent is at his/her personal low.

7_of_spades.name: 7 of Spades
7_of_spades.meaning: Advice that is best not taken; loss. There is some obstacle to success, and this indicates that obstacles may be coming from within the querent.

5_of_spades.name: 5 of Spades
5_of_spades.meaning: Opposition and obstacles that are temporary; a blessing in disguise. Sometimes indicates a negative or depressed person.

4_of_spades.name: 4 of Spades
4_of_spades.meaning: Small worries, problems. Financial difficulties, personal lows.

3_of_spades.name: 3 of Spades
3_of_spades.meaning: Breaks in relationships. Sometimes indicates that a third person is breaking into a relationship somehow.

2_of_spades.name: 2 of Spades
2_of_spades.meaning: Breaks in relationships; deceit. A break in an important process in the querent’s life. If the question concerns a particular romantic interest, this is considered a warning card – infidelity or separation is quite likely.

ace_of_diamonds.name: Ace of Diamonds
ace_of_diamonds.meaning: Change; a message, often about money, and usually good news.

king_of_diamonds.name: King of Diamonds
king_of_diamonds.meaning: Fair-haired or graying man, or a man with Earth predominating in his chart. A man of authority, status, or influence.

queen_of_diamonds.name: Queen of Diamonds
queen_of_diamonds.meaning: Fair-haired woman; or a woman with Earth predominating in her chart. A gossip.

jack_of_diamonds.name: Jack of Diamonds
jack_of_diamonds.meaning: A youth, possibly in uniform. Or, a jealous person who may be unreliable. A person who brings news, generally negative, but relatively minor.

10_of_diamonds.name: 10 of Diamonds
10_of_diamonds.meaning: A change in financial status, often for the better.

9_of_diamonds.name: 9 of Diamonds
9_of_diamonds.meaning: A new business deal; travel; restlessness; a change of residence.

8_of_diamonds.name: 8 of Diamonds
8_of_diamonds.meaning: New job; change in job situation. The young or the old may find love on a trip.

7_of_diamonds.name: 7 of Diamonds
7_of_diamonds.meaning: An argument concerning finances, or on the job. Generally expected to be resolved happily.

5_of_diamonds.name: 5 of Diamonds
5_of_diamonds.meaning: Happiness and success. A change for the better. A birth, or good news for a child. A good time to start new projects.

4_of_diamonds.name: 4 of Diamonds
4_of_diamonds.meaning: Financial upswing; an older person may give good advice.

3_of_diamonds.name: 3 of Diamonds
3_of_diamonds.meaning: A legal letter. Be tactful with others in order to avoid disputes.

2_of_diamonds.name: 2 of Diamonds
2_of_diamonds.meaning: A business partnership; a change in relationship; gossip.
